description: This is a C source file implementing utility functions for protocol type determination, UBUS communication, and response handling in a system that interacts with ubus (OpenWrt's system bus). It includes functions to get protocol types, match protocols, perform synchronous ubus calls, and handle responses via callbacks.

methods.name: unsigned int get_proto_type(const char * proto)
methods.description: Determines protocol type based on the given string, returning constants representing CWMP, USP, or BOTH.

methods.name: unsigned int get_proto_type_option_value(struct blob_attr * msg)
methods.description: Parses blob attributes to extract protocol type option and returns corresponding protocol type constant.

methods.name: bool proto_matches(unsigned int dm_type,const enum bbfdmd_type_enum type)
methods.description: Checks whether a given protocol type matches a specified bbfdmd type, considering 'BOTH' and 'NONE' conditions.

methods.name: void run_sync_call(const char * ubus_obj,const char * ubus_method,struct blob_attr * msg,struct blob_buf * bb_response)
methods.description: Performs a synchronous ubus call with specified object, method, and message; processes the response via callback.

methods.name: void sync_callback(struct ubus_request * req,int type,struct blob_attr * msg)

ctags.name: proto_matches
ctags.pattern: /^bool proto_matches(unsigned int dm_type, const enum bbfdmd_type_enum type)$/
